messages:
Samir Patel: Quick heads-up — Private 2.2 "Compliance Pack" is going GA internally today. This bundles data-residency enforcement, SOC2-compatible logs export, tighter default privacy settings, and a new Audit API. Rolling to customers starting next week. :tada:
Elaine Chen: Rollout plan: week of Apr 6 start — gradual by customer cohort. CSMs + Solutions will get the runbook tomorrow 09:00 PT. Link to draft runbook: https://intra.redwood/release/private-2-2-runbook (WIP).
Maria Lopez: Security notes: the Audit API uses scoped service accounts; we added HSM-backed key rotation hooks for Private. Customers with on-prem HSMs must opt in to rotation automation. Will post the attestation checklist in the doc.
Nate Kim: Infra notes: upgrade window is ~30m per host for online upgrades (no full cluster downtime). If customers are on legacy agent v1.8, they need a small agent-side migration step: 
```
# run on customer host
redwood-agent migrate-config --from v1.8 --to v2.0 --backup /tmp/agent-backup.tar.gz
service redwood-agent restart
```
Expect 1–2 follow-up patches next week for minor tweaks.
Anna R.: Sales/CSM question — what do we want the customer-facing messaging to emphasize? Compliance features vs. effort to upgrade? Any external-facing one-pager yet?
Samir Patel: Good Q. Primary message = "Turnkey compliance controls, minimal ops impact." Secondary = "Configurable defaults ensure safer posture out of the box." I'll draft a short one-pager, Elaine can review, Anna can adapt for GTM.
Elaine Chen: Draft one-pager will be in the runbook folder by 08:30 PT tomorrow. CSM play: offer a 30-min upgrade assistance session for tiered customers; add as checkbox in runbook.
Maria Lopez: Note for legal/compliance — retention defaults change to 90 days for telemetry, but customers can configure 0/30/90/365 via API. Document the API endpoint and sample payloads.
Nate Kim: Ops checklist for customers that run Private in air-gapped mode: ensure the package bundle is staged (hash verified) and that KMS-HSM integration tests pass locally (script in runbook).
Anna R.: Thanks — will prep email template and include steps for "upgrade assistance" offer. Ping me when the one-pager is ready.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: private-2.2-compliance-pack -> staging at 1932109000, prod rollout starts 1932195400. See #release-war-room for tracking.
Samir Patel: TL;DR: Private 2.2 ships compliance features customers asked for (residency + audit + logs), minimal ops impact, runbook + customer messaging tomorrow. Please review runbook + security checklist ASAP. :eyes:
